# langsmith_tool (Data Source)

Looks up a LangSmith platform tool by `handle`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tool" "lookup_customer" {
  handle = "lookup-customer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String)

- `description` (String)
